title: RAE-PPG: Duration-Grounded Retain-and-Extend Pretraining for PPG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.36794v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Signal features derived from photoplethysmography (PPG) require different signal durations to characterize. Existing PPG foundation models treat duration as a pretraining or evaluation condition rather than using the different durations required by PPG features to organize self-supervision. We hypothesize that self-supervision should expand with signal duration, allowing a single encoder to progressively acquire additional features while preserving and reusing earlier learning. We introduce Retain-and-Extend PPG (RAE-PPG), which trains a single Transformer encoder successively on 10 s, 30 s, and 240 s inputs, adding supervision for signal features supported by each longer observation. The encoder is partitioned into duration-specific parameter groups, allowing later stages to reuse earlier groups while updating only the group assigned to the current stage. translated_title: RAE-PPG：面向PPG基础模型的基于时长的保留与扩展预训练方法
translated_abstract: 从光电容积脉搏波（PPG）中提取的信号特征需要不同的信号时长来刻画。现有的PPG基础模型将时长视为预训练或评估的条件，而不是利用PPG特征所需的不同时长来组织自监督学习。我们假设自监督应随信号时长而扩展，使单个编码器能够逐步获取额外特征，同时保留并复用先前学到的知识。我们提出了保留与扩展PPG（RAE-PPG），该方法在10秒、30秒和240秒输入上依次训练单个Transformer编码器，为每种更长观测所支持的信号特征添加监督。编码器被划分为按时长划分的参数组，使后续阶段能够复用先前的参数组，同时仅更新分配给当前阶段的参数组。选定的早期目标被复用以监督后续阶段，鼓励……
tldr: RAE-PPG提出了一种基于信号时长的递进式自监督预训练方法，通过将编码器划分为不同时长专属的参数组并复用早期学习目标，使单个Transformer编码器能够依次在10秒、30秒和240秒的PPG信号上逐步获取、保留并复用多时间尺度的信号特征。
en_tdlr: RAE-PPG introduces a duration-grounded retain-and-extend pretraining strategy that progressively expands self-supervision across 10s, 30s, and 240s PPG inputs by partitioning the encoder into duration-specific parameter groups, enabling a single Transformer encoder to progressively acquire, preserve, and reuse features at multiple timescales.
